category_edits.rationale: Apply smooth row-norm compression e/sqrt(1+||e||²/d) to the shared input and output item embeddings across all four datasets. This may reduce domination by large-norm items while preserving embedding dimensions, tying, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the modified model class, so it uses identical normalization without checkpoint changes.

def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))

def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:

edits.find:
def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = self.aggregate_states(out, seq)
        pos_scores = (out * self.item_emb(pos)).sum(dim=-1)
        neg_scores = (out * self.item_emb(neg)).sum(dim=-1)
        return pos_scores, neg_scores
